class.name: TreeWind3D
class.brief_description: Wind, touch, colliders and snapping branches for rigged trees ([member TreeGenerator.rigged]).
class.description: Moves the MultiMesh instance bones of rigged trees under [member target]. Every bone is a damped cantilever spring; its motion is the turbulence filtered by that oscillator, in closed form: the [WeatherMap3D] gust waves through the bone's quasi-static gain, plus a narrow-band sway at its own frequency (Davenport 1961; Shinya and Fournier 1992; Stam 1997). It is stateless, so poses are deterministic in [member time] and the whole forest stays coherent, and raster and the path tracer skin the same pose. Nodes in [member touch_group] push branches aside (they spring back at their own frequency), and fast ones snap thin branches off as rigid bodies. Trunks and limbs get static capsule colliders near the camera. See docs/ideas/trees.md, sections 3a and 7a.

method.name: get_bone_bends
method.description: For tests: each bone's turn relative to its parent (axis times angle, tree space) for [param mesh] placed at [param placement], at the current [member time].

method.name: get_mesh_bone_count
method.description: Bones of a rigged mesh (0 if it has no rig).

method.name: get_piece_count
method.description: Snapped branches still in the scene.

method.name: get_rig_frequencies
method.description: Each bone's sway frequency (Hz) at scale 1: one per axis, by Rayleigh's quotient on its static shape.

method.name: get_lod_bias
method.description: How far [member budget_msec] has coarsened the level of detail: 1 at [member lod_pixel_error], up to 8.

method.name: get_skipped_instances
method.description: Instances in range that the level of detail held at their last pose in the last [method update].

method.name: get_solved_instances
method.description: Instances posed by the last [method update].

method.name: get_target_count
method.description: MultiMeshes of rigged trees found under [member target].

method.name: get_touch_bends
method.description: For tests: the touch turn of each bone of one instance (empty when it is not being touched or springing back).

method.name: make_multimesh
method.description: A MultiMesh of [param mesh] at rest at each of [param transforms], with one record per bone per instance ([member MultiMesh.bones_per_instance]), as [TreeWind3D] and the rigged materials expect.

method.name: rescan
method.description: Forgets the targets found so far and looks for them again (also done every second).

method.name: update
method.description: Advances [member time] by [param delta] and poses every instance in range. Called each frame while [member active].

members.member: Updates every frame by itself. Off: call [method update].

Turbulence intensity (sigma over mean) without a weather map.
Wind at 10 m (x, z; m/s) without a weather map.

Solves each tree at the rate and with the bones its size on screen can show, and trees out of view (and their shadows) at a low rate. Needs a perspective camera; without one every tree is solved in full.
Largest pose error on screen (pixels) the level of detail may leave, from a pose held for some frames or a small bone riding its parent.
Largest turn of one bone (radians), approached smoothly.

Node searched (with its children and internal children) for MultiMeshInstance3Ds of rigged trees.

How hard a body pushes: bones stiffer than this (N m per radian) yield proportionally less, so twigs give way and trunks do not.
